subject: COBOL-WORDS directive
notes: kb/Work PB1373 landed (w1019 G). SR4 'The content of literal-2, literal-5, and literal-6 shall not be a reserved word, a context-sensitive word, nor an intrinsic function-name. The content of each of these literals shall be a COBOL word that meets the requirements for a user-defined data-name as specified in 8.3.2.2' (cite.py OK §7.3.10.3 4)). Population: the same 2023 one as SR3, so RESERVE AUTHOR (a fresh word) is accepted (was COBOL1623). Form: the §8.3.2.1 word shape (underscore a word character, neither hyphen nor underscore first or last), §8.3.2.2 at least one letter, and CobolWordRule's 63-character ceiling and Annex B placement (a 64-character fresh word is COBOL1623); MY_SHOW is legal. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Validation/VersionConformancePass.cs#IsReservedCategory (IsReservedCategory was replaced by IsReservedContextOrIntrinsic, the one 2023 population that SR3 and SR4 share) kb/Work PB4239 (wave 20261863 A): the same population includes the section 4.2.10 additions, so RESERVE "JSON" and EQUATE "MOVE" WITH "COMP-3" are COBOL1623 SR4 (both compiled clean), and the sentence names the reservation (section 4.2.10, D-RW1). kb/Work PB4586: judged by CobolWordsCategoryPass beside the parse. retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Validation/VersionConformancePass.cs#IsReservedContextOrIntrinsic (the SR3/SR4 category rules moved out of VersionConformancePass into CobolWordsCategoryPass (kb/Work PB4586), so these members no longer exist)
